Cally Cave House
We are proud to present Cally Cave House created with love to the local architecture and landscape. Cally Cave House, a fully renovated traditional Cave accommodation of Santorini, is not only a nice accommodation, but an opportunity to experience the original Santorinian way of living. Hewn vertically into the volcanic soil, which keep the house warm in winter and cold in summer, the rooms are narrow-fronted and built in the rock without any foundation. At the front is the parlour, while the bedroom is at the back, lighted and aired though the parlour and the tiny ventilation tube.
The House has been designed according to the traditional architecture of Santorini (Cave House), but also to deliver high standards of modern comfort. It consists of 4 separate suites and can accommodate up to 13 guests. Large swimming pool is equipped with comfortable sun beds. This is opportunity for your family and friends to stay together in the quiet place, but still close to cosmopolitan Fira town.

Dimitris I. Xylas
a month ago
★★★★★ ★★★★★
We stayed at Cally Cave House for 5 nights and we enjoyed every last one of them! The place is quiet, not on a busy road and don't be afraid to choose it even though you don't have a specific view to look at while you are relaxing at the pool. It's located in a very central position which you can get everywhere in Santorini within 20-25 minutes. The owner was extremely helpful and the breakfast was everything we needed to start our day. The private jacuzzi in the room was a wonderful experience to have. I would definitely recommend it and personally I would choose it again.

Allison Anderson
a year ago
★★★★★ ★★★★★
Vasilis and his brother are incredibly gracious hosts. They are super friendly and helpful when asking for directions or rides into town. They kept the place looking spectacular during our stay. The pictures on their site are incredibly accurate so you know just what you are booking online. The houses are gorgeous! Worked perfectly for our family's stay in Santorini!
Opas Klinhom
3 years ago
★★★★★ ★★★★★
Wonderful place to stay for family vacation. We are family of 4, the youngest is 3.5 years old and she really enjoyed the stay. Our accommodation - Cave 2 - was lovely, cool, clean, and very peaceful at night. Also, not forget to mention a gorgeous breakfast delivered to your cave house in the morning. The location was a short walk to Fira central, approx. 15 minutes' stroll. The staff was extremely friendly and helpful, especially Vasilis, who picked us up from the airport and was always there to help or can easily be contacted via WhatsApp. We strongly recommend Cally Cave House, especially for young families, and we would definitely stay here again!
